title: Critical Poisson fields and information-adapted conditioning
summary: Poisson laws for the actual run field with positions, all excesses and signs; hard and soft small-prime conditioning, deterministic masks and statistics, stable recorded variables, uniform quenched convergence, and an information-adapted cutoff that respects a prescribed conditioning floor.
